neighbours.label: first piece of a multi-token prefixed past participle (re-/over-/mis-) after an auxiliary ("was re|-ex|amined", "be res|ampled"); quiet on the infinitive
fire: The grant proposal was re-evaluated by an outside panel in March.
The forms have been resubmitted with the missing signatures.
Her illness was misdiagnosed for almost two years.
The cost of the tunnel was overestimated by a wide margin.
The old instruments were recalibrated before the survey began.
The front door has been repainted in a darker green.
The jars were mislabelled at the factory and had to be recalled.
The used car was resold within a week at a small profit.
quiet: The grant proposal was read by an outside panel in March.
The forms have been signed and sent with the missing pages.
Her illness was treated for almost two years.
The cost of the tunnel was high by a wide margin.
The old instruments were cleaned before the survey began.
The front door has been left in a darker green.
The jars were packed at the factory and had to be shipped.
The used car was sold within a week at a small profit.

notes: Probes: be re-examined 1.10, widely-spoken 0.77, be resampled 0.86, was resurfaced 0.53; to re-examine 0.03, plain participles ~0.2 (peak ' was').
